areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Drainage corrections for resilience to extreme climate events, greenhouse-gas reduction and environmental management measures.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Innovative public contracting and management models focused on results, notably PPP structuring for infrastructure.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Safer student access to public schools is a project objective monitored by a specific indicator.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: Uses public-private partnerships for financing, encouraging private participation in execution and maintenance.

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Programme has no energy-efficiency or renewable-energy actions.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Drainage improvement is an indirect benefit outside the core scope and already counted under 1.1.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Soil conservation and aquifer recharge measures are complementary, not core scope.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Wildlife-barrier reduction is a complementary action, not core scope.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Economic development from better roads is an indirect benefit, not core scope.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Possible benefit to small businesses is indirect, not core scope.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Construction jobs are an indirect benefit, not core scope.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Road improvements help vulnerable populations only indirectly; not core scope.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Better roads through indigenous and quilombola communities are an indirect benefit, not core scope.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: Safer access to education and work for youth, women and minorities is an indirect benefit, not core scope.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Modern monitoring and management technologies are used, but the project is not pioneering in them.
